summary: Preserve the last confirmed rollback build when activation was interrupted before its retention state write.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only retention correction. Existing activation state and build directory formats remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change.

recovery.detail: Application data is unchanged. The last confirmed publication remains the rollback target when the edge already serves a newer build after an interrupted activation.
